title: coordination.md and tools.md say what reads kbsettings.effective today, not what will
goal: the docs name as readers of kbsettings.effective only the tools that import it, and name the coord hook, kbmon and the explain command once each of them does

run:
import glob, re, sys
src = lambda p: open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
ks = src("_tools/kbsettings.py")
m = re.search(r"\ndef explain\(.*?(?=\ndef |\Z)", ks, re.S)
reads = {
    "coord hook": "kbsettings.effective(" in src(".claude/hooks/coord_hook.py"),
    "kbmon": any("kbsettings.effective(" in src(f) for f in glob.glob("_tools/mon_*.py")),
    "explain command": bool(m and re.search(r"\beffective\(", m.group(0))),
}
lines = [l for p in ("kb/_self/coordination.md", "kb/_self/tools.md") for l in src(p).splitlines() if "kbsettings.effective" in l]
wrong = [n for n, r in reads.items() if not r and any(n in l for l in lines)]
missing = [n for n, r in reads.items() if r and not any(n in l for l in lines)]
print("code reads effective:", reads, "| docs name a non-reader:", wrong, "| docs omit a reader:", missing)
sys.exit(1 if wrong or missing else 0)
